title: 26 CFR 301.7701-3, Classification of certain business entities (4-1-25 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Code of Federal Regulations

passages.question: What is HANGS Property Holdings LLC for tax if it made no election?
passages.excerpt: unless the entity elects otherwise, a domestic eligible entity is— (i) A partnership if it has two or more members; or (ii) Disregarded as an entity separate from its owner if it has a single owner.
